item.title: PSA: Hitman: Absolution's Switch 2 Upgrade Path Is Free For Now, But Be Quick!

description.p: Limited-time freebie.Hitman: Absolution - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition finally snuck onto the new console earlier this week, and it's free to all those who own the game on Switch 1! At least, it's free for now.Yes, as flagged by Feral Interactive, the upgrade path to the Switch 2 edition is only free until 4th November, while the game itself is subject to a 10% launch discount. item.title: Capcom Data Breach Results In Unauthorised Access To More Than 11.7 Million 'CAPCOM ID' Accounts

Apparently, only "43 of the cases" leaked additional details such as birth dates, gender, country/region and nicknames.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Pokémon Apps Are Coming Back Online After Extended Cybersecurity Outage

description.p: Sleep, HOME and Champions all went down yesterday.You may have read yesterday about the cybersecurity alert that hit sites and apps around the world after two vulnerabilities were found in the popular programming language, PHP. The Pokémon Company were one of the many teams hit by the outage, with Pokémon HOME, Sleep and Champions all going offline yesterday without an end time in sight. Well, fortunately, they have started to come back.As shared on the apps' official social media accounts, it seems that TPC is now on top of the issue and is in the process of restoring functionality. Champions was the first to come back online at around 3am BST this morning, followed by HOME a few hours later. Pokémon Sleep was a little later to join the party, but ended its maintenance around 10am BST.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: A Permanent Pokémon Store Is Finally Coming To London

description.p: The first of "several" outside Asia.After years of us leaving the pop-up shop at the European International Championships and wondering, "why isn't this a permanent thing?", it seems our wishes have finally been answered.The Pokémon Company has today announced that a "permanent, physical Pokémon store" is set to open in London.
